R.DEVDAS J., (ORAL):

This Miscellaneous First Appeal is filed at the hands of the claimant/owner of the acquired land aggrieved by the judgment and award passed by the Civil Judge, Senior Division, Mudhol in LAC No.259/2005 dated 11.02.2013 seeking enhancement of the compensation.

2. At the outset, learned HCGP submits that similar matters were considered at the hands of the learned Single Judge of this Court, since those matters fall within the pecuniary jurisdiction of the learned Single Judge in MFA No.103386/2015 dated 03.01.2018 which was later followed in MFA No.103384/2015 dated 12.02.2020.
3.

We have gone through the judgment passed in MFA No.103386/2015 and we find that claims have been made in the said appeal that the market value for Pomegranate grown on the land was considered at a lower rate.
Similar grounds are raised in the present appeal also.

It is not disputed that the lands in question are situated at Hebbal Village, Mudhol taluk and therefore, the learned counsel for the appellant does not dispute that, since the lands in question are similarly situated and the claim arise out of the same notification.
4.

Consequently, this appeal is disposed off in terms of the orders passed in MFA No.103386/2015 and MFA No.103384/2015, wherein the award was modified having regard to the fact that the assessment of the market value of the Pomegranate grown in the lands were taken on a lower side.

Ordered accordingly.
It is needless to observe that if the appellant is able to establish that the Kharab land is 'A' kharab which is alienable, then appellant may lay a claim to the said portion of the land also.
